idea-plugin.name: D1 JDBC Connector
idea-plugin.description:
Browse, query and edit Cloudflare® D1 databases in the database tools.

Add a data source and select D1 JDBC Connector. Choose Cloudflare sign-in to sign in with Cloudflare in the browser, or API token to use a token with D1 permission and your account ID. The IDE downloads the open source driver from GitHub when you first connect.

Source code and help: github.com/simontong/d1-jdbc
